rules.title: Agent configuration directory read
rules.description: Code reads the agent's own configuration directory, which holds settings and credentials the skill usually has no need for. Intent and resulting usage of read configuration should be analyzed in detail.

read.subject: trace
read.question: Where does what the marked code reads from the configuration of the agent go?

options.stays-local: it is parsed, shown or edited on the machine and goes nowhere else.
options.sent-or-logged: it is sent to a host or written to a log.
options.not-a-match: the text reads no configuration file: a prose mention of MCP tools or a list of tool names.
options.unknown: the state does not show where what is read goes.

purpose.subject: entry
purpose.question: The about line names a place where the skill reads the configuration of the agent or of its MCP servers. What is the purpose of this skill?

options.manages-settings: the purpose of the skill is managing the settings of the agent or of its MCP servers.

rules.title: MCP configuration read
rules.description: Code reads an MCP server configuration, which holds server URLs, tokens and tool definitions. Intent and resulting usage of read configuration should be analyzed in detail.
